remote_http_oidc.title: Claude/Web with OIDC
remote_http_oidc.description: Use the remote HTTP transport with OAuth/OIDC authentication. Choose this for Claude or browser-based remote clients.

local_sse.title: Local SSE without OIDC
local_sse.description: Use the local SSE transport for desktop MCP clients like LM Studio. This mode does not require the OIDC integration. Connect desktop clients to /api/mcp/sse.

local_streamable_http.title: Local Streamable HTTP without OIDC
local_streamable_http.description: Use the local Streamable HTTP transport for MCP clients that expect HTTP transport, including LM Studio via direct HTTP. This mode does not require the OIDC integration. Connect clients to /api/mcp.

abort.oidc_provider_required: The OIDC Provider integration is required but not installed. Please install hass-oidc-provider from {oidc_provider_url} first.
